_note: Story 048: when the client asks for a fix during the service. asks: her service-talk lines (and the redo line) that open a request of that kind. patterns: case-insensitive regular expressions that catch the same ask in her AI replies during the service. A request is fixed once the player has used a fix tool (Clean up, Remover) after she asked and the nails then meet the kind's test: edge = every nail's neatness at least edge.minNeatness; length = shorter (or longer, if she asked for longer) than when she asked; colour = a different base colour than when she asked, painted to at least colour.minCoverage on average. fixedMood / openMood: her mood change when it is fixed, or still open at Done. skills: problem handling is at least fixedFloor when every request was fixed, at most openCap when one was left open. lines: what she says (thanks when fixed, open when still not fixed at Done). Story 058: the same requests after Done (at checkout): her complaint, or the player offering a fix (playerOffers, English and Vietnamese), shows a Fix it button in the chat that reopens the station on the Fix it step. A colour that is not what she asked for ("a bit more red than coral") is a colour request.
